intro: Lesson 94: Feedback and gap closing. To understand my strengths and gaps from the end-of-year papers and start to close them

questions.q: Correct two questions from your papers in green pen, labelling each error (slip, misread, method).
questions.model: Teacher corrects one paper question with the class.

questions.q: Do 5 practice questions on your weakest topic (portal set).
Write a 'watch out' tip for a Year 5 pupil about one common error.
questions.a: For example: 'Never add the denominators: make them the same first.'

questions.q: Big question: what did the papers show?
questions.a: Answers will vary: one strength and one gap
